node.statement: For every index i in I the total variation of the fiber-aggregated masses is bounded: sum_Q |c^{(i)}_Q| <= 1 + 2t, since row i has total mass 1 and row negative mass nu_i <= t; moreover the positive part has total mass at most 1 + t and the negative part total mass at most t.
